BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   C. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   C. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Money as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   C. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   B. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   D. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Global Influence in Business 3.1 Public and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. D — Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. C — Plan income and spending wisely

10. D — Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Entrepreneurship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Global Influence in Business 3.1 Public; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
